flows.period: week ending 2 September 2026 (most recent published EPFR/BofA Flow Show data; no fresher weekly report found)
flows.narrative: In the week ended 2 Sep 2026, investors kept rotating out of US equities into cash and high-grade bonds, extending a three-week ~$14.2bn drawdown from US equity funds -- the largest since January 2026 -- even as global equity funds overall still eked out roughly $7bn/week of net inflows (down sharply from ~$52bn/week in July). Money-market funds absorbed nearly $23bn in the latest week, and the prior week (ended 28 Aug) had already seen a flight into gold (+$7.3bn, biggest since Oct 2025) and crypto (+$3.2bn) as a Thursday-PPI-style risk-off hedge. This data predates Friday's CPI-driven rally, so it reflects cautious positioning built up into the print, not the relief move itself.
